# Fluxrow

> Creative intelligence agency building AI-powered websites, automations, and operator systems for businesses.

Fluxrow combines design, engineering, and AI to ship production systems: marketing sites, conversational agents, internal dashboards, and the AI Operator Kit (English-language playbook for solo operators).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Agency overview, services, cases, and process.
- [Contato](/contato): Contact form and direct channels.
- [Curso](/curso): Course landing page.
- [Conteúdos](/conteudos): Index of long-form content and guides.
- [AI Operator Kit](/kit): Sales page for the AI Operator Kit (English).
- [Kit Content](/kit/content): Kit reader for buyers.
- [Política de Privacidade](/politica-de-privacidade): LGPD privacy policy.
- [Termos de Uso](/termos-de-uso): Terms of service.
